thread:
asha-cs: Quick heads-up — overnight onboarding pipelines for several enterprise trials returned repeated 5xx errors (02:10–03:05 UTC). Affected tenants are stuck at provisioning. I'm pulling list now.

maya-onboard: Ugh. Any idea scope? which regions/pools?

leo-sre: We're seeing spikes hitting the dedicated-pool autoscaler; kernel OOMs on some quantized shards. Rolling a non-disruptive restart on the pool now.

asha-cs: Thanks Leo. Maya — prioritize any customers with renewals in next 60 days. Diego, can you surface the top-10 at-risk ARR?

diego-ae: On it. Pulling from SFDC and renewal tracker now. Expect list in ~15m. Concerned about three Tier-1 trials that just went live last week.

nate-ops: FYI, I enabled a temporary fallback routing to hosted-compat models for onboarding flows to reduce failures. That should let more onboards complete but may increase unit costs.

maya-onboard: Good — can we run a targeted enablement session for affected customers? Quick walkthrough reduces churn. I can offer two 30-min slots this week.

asha-cs: Yes. Offer session + one-time platform credit. Draft outbound below — please edit.

asha-cs: "Hi <customer-name>, we experienced a provisioning disruption last night that may have delayed your onboarding. We're very sorry. We've applied a one-time account credit, re-routed in-progress onboards, and can schedule a 30-min walkthrough this week to get you fully live. Would Thursday 10–10:30 or Friday 16–16:30 work? — Asha, Redwood CS"

diego-ae: Edit: add "we understand this intersects with your renewal window; we'll prioritize handoff and a tailored enablement plan."

leo-sre: RCABot posted initial postmortem draft in #incidents. Key cause: memory regression in quantized kernel after yesterday's runtime update; mitigated by rollback and pool restart.

rca-bot: [auto] Initial RCA drafted: regression introduced in runtime v3.9.2 -> fallback routing enabled -> rollback to v3.9.1 completed at 03:20 UTC. Next: patch with improved memory checks.

maya-onboard: Action items: 1) Asha/Dego send prioritized outreach by EOD. 2) Maya to schedule enablement and attach quick-start checklist. 3) Nate/Leo confirm permanent fix ETA and customer-facing timeline.

asha-cs: I'll send outbound to the top-10 with the edited copy and include credit amounts. Diego — paste the SFDC owner list in thread when ready.

diego-ae: Here are the top-10 (pasted to internal SFDC note). Flagging three high-risk: Acme Labs, NovaRetail, FinEdge.

asha-cs: Sending drafts now. Will loop in account execs and CSMs. Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the credit amounts and wording so I can blast by 18:00 UTC.

leo-sre: :thumbsup: from infra. Follow-up: we'll publish a short status note for customers with technical details and mitigation steps.

nate-ops: I'll follow up with a timeline for the patch and ETA in the customer note.

asha-cs: Perfect. After outreach we'll capture feedback in the renewal-risk tracker and schedule deeper exec briefings for the three flagged accounts. Closing the loop here once emails go out.

maya-onboard: Thanks team — I'll prep the enablement deck and checklist and link them into the customer replies.

diego-ae: Sent to owners, and pinged Acme Labs' sponsor to offer an executive call.

asha-cs: Thread update: outbound sent at 17:42 UTC, credits applied, enablement slots booked for those who responded. Will post a short customer-facing status note once Leo/Nate confirm patch ETA.

rca-bot: [auto] Final note: rollback successful; follow-up patch scheduled for next maintenance window.

asha-cs: Thanks everyone. We'll track renewal risk changes in tomorrow's morning sync and escalate if churn signal increases.
